raw_segments.text: Ophidias, bolder though not so subtle.
My valor's poisoned with only suffering stain by him, for him shall fly out of itself.
Nor sleep nor sanctuary, being naked, sick, nor fain nor capital, the prayers of priests
nor times of sacrifice, embarkments all of fury, shall lift up their rotten privilege
and custom, against my hate to Mardius.
Where I find him, were it at home, upon my brother's guard, even there against the hospitable
cannon, would I wash my fierce hand in's heart.
Go you to T.H. City, learn how T's held, and what they are that must be hostages for Rome.
